newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Tubacex net through May up 17.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Tubacex net through May up 17.9 pct.

text.p: Spain's steel group Tubacex said on Thursday in the first five months of the year it had net profit of 1.77 billion pesetas, 17.9 percent higher than the year-ago same period.
In a statement, the company added that it expects to end 1997 with net consolidated profit of 3.5 billion pesetas, which will be 12 percent more than the 1996's result.
After Tubacex paid back money to its shareholders this past March in a seven percent capital reduction, the firm announced today it intends to continue with the same policy.
Before this operation, nominal share value stood at 100 pesetas and is now at 93 pesetas.

"The board does not imagine this as an isolated act, but expects the shareholders payback to go on until it reaches a 75 pesetas per share, which is 25 percent lower than initial value," the statement said.
Thereafter, it added, "it will start a policy of regular and increasing dividends."
